card.name: Inside brand and generic drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through a long drug name, on a middle piece of a brand or generic name (e.g. Flumazenil, escitalopram, ZOLADEX). It appears in label text where the drug is the subject of a sentence.

modes.label: Generic drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a generic name such as flumazenil, escitalopram, chlordiazepoxide.
modes.example: To minimize the likelihood of pain at the injection site, Flum<<azen>>il Injection, USP should be administered

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: Middle piece of an all-caps brand name used as the subject of a sentence.
modes.example: There is an increased risk for pregnancy loss due to expected hormone changes that occur with ZOLA<<DEX>> treatment

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long drug name, before the name is finished.
